# Jonathan Roemer

> Systems architect and engineering leader with 15+ years across infrastructure, security, compliance, product and AI. Senior Principal Systems Architect at Cytracom, and runs Cygnus Strategy, a boutique consultancy. Amateur radio operator KA1PID; GMRS WSOD974.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pid1.space/index.md): who he is, in a few lines
- [About](https://pid1.space/about.md): background, education and approach
- [Projects](https://pid1.space/projects.md): personal projects in AI tooling, full-stack web apps, ham radio and cyber-physical hardware, and the apps and APIs made by Cygnus Strategy
- [Contact](https://pid1.space/contact.md): email, GitHub, LinkedIn and ham radio nodes

## Elsewhere

- [Cygnus Strategy](https://cygnusstrategy.com/): fractional CTO, CPO, CISO and COO leadership, and apps (https://cygnusstrategy.com/apps)
- [Albireo](https://albireo.cygnusstrategy.com/): free live solar data and HF band conditions for apps and AI agents, as an API and MCP server, computed from NOAA and ITU data. No key needed, and the band conditions card on this site runs on it.
